description.zh:
数据库备注说明，备注说明需满足如下要求： 
* 不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。 
* 长度为2~256个字符。
description.en:
The description of the database. The description must meet the following requirements:

- Cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

- Must be 2 to 256 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb modify-db-description --db-cluster-id pc-000000000000000 --db-name testDB --db-description DBDesc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb ModifyDBDescription --region cn-hangzhou --DBDescription DBDesc --DBClusterId 'pc-000000000000000' --DBName testDB
